record.question: A Government servant is invited to become treasurer of an organisation that regularly supports political movements, though it is not registered as a political party. Under CCS (Conduct) Rules, he should:
options: accept because the organisation is not formally a political party
accept if he handles only accounts and not political speeches
not associate with it if the organisation takes part in politics or political activity
accept after informing his immediate superior orally
